findings.evidence: code/TauCeti/Geometry/Manifold/Complex/Orientation.lean:346 `def complexOrientationLift : Manifold.OrientationLift 𝓘(ℝ, E) M (Fin (finrank ℝ E)) := Manifold.OrientationLift.ofHasGroupoid ...`; RealForm.lean:250 `abbrev orientationLift ... := Manifold.OrientationLift.ofHasGroupoid Complex.orientation (by simp)`.
findings.fix: Move the orientation to `TauCeti/Geometry/Manifold/Complex/Orientation.lean` next to `complexOrientationLift` (or use `complexOrientationLift ℂ X` directly), and update the uses in Theorem.lean.
findings.issue: `TauCeti.RiemannSurface.orientationLift` (the orientation of the complex structure, `OrientationLift.ofHasGroupoid Complex.orientation`) is placed in RealForm.lean, which is about the real form of a 1-form. The canonical home for complex-manifold orientation lifts is `Geometry/Manifold/Complex/Orientation.lean`, which already defines the same construction as `TauCeti.complexOrientationLift`.

findings.evidence: RealForm.lean diff header adds `public import TauCeti.Geometry.Manifold.DifferentialForm.Integration.Regularity` and `import TauCeti.Analysis.Green.Comparison.Area.Basic`; the only new user of either import in RealForm is this lemma (`Green.basisOneI_addHaar`, `integralTopForm_eq_chartIntegral`).
findings.fix: Move the lemma, together with the orientation, out of RealForm.lean into a file about Riemann-surface orientation/integration (beside the orientation in the Complex/Orientation area, or a new `RiemannSurface/Integration` file), and drop the two added imports from RealForm.lean.
findings.issue: `integralTopForm_orientationLift_eq_integral` is a statement about integrating a top form in a chart of a Riemann surface; it has nothing to do with the real form of a 1-form. To support it, RealForm gains `public import ...DifferentialForm.Integration.Regularity` and `import TauCeti.Analysis.Green.Comparison.Area.Basic`, which every importer of RealForm then inherits.

summary: Most new declarations are well placed, but the orientation lift of a Riemann surface and its chart-integral lemma were added to RealForm.lean (about the real form of a 1-form) instead of the existing complex-manifold orientation file. That also brings integration and Green-comparison imports into RealForm.
